profile.headline: Technical Lead Software Developer at Rocket
profile.summary:
Manager DevOps & Developer Experience, Developer Pipeline & Release Manager, and Business Analyst with a demonstrated ability to deliver. Strong leadership skills with the ability to organize, motivate, and mentor diverse teams in the US and abroad. Productive team member with excellent written and oral communication skills who is adaptable to differing functional roles and personality types. Former developer on large scale software programs interacting with custom Oracle databases.

Specialties:
 •	DevOps & Developer Experience (Github Actions)
 •	Engineering Pipeline and Release Management
 •	Business Analysis
•	Requirements Elicitation
•	Verbal, Written Communication
•	Team Building and Mentoring
•	Team Leadership
•	Software Lifecycles
•	Multitasking
•	Troubleshooting / Analysis
•	Estimation
•	CMM
•	System, Network Admin.
•	Data Design / Migration
